description: This file defines React components and utility functions related to authentication using Clerk. It includes provider setup, route guards, sign-in/sign-up pages, and user controls.

methods.name: getClerkPublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Clerk publishable key from environment variables; warns if missing.

methods.name: AppAuthProvider
methods.description: Wraps application components with ClerkProvider, configures routing, and provides navigation functions.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: A route guard component that renders children if user is signed in, else prompts sign-in.

methods.name: SignInPage
methods.description: Component rendering the sign-in page with Clerk's SignIn component.

methods.name: SignUpPage
methods.description: Component rendering the sign-up page with Clerk's SignUp component.

methods.name: AuthControls
methods.description: Component that shows sign-in link when signed out, or user button when signed in.
